item.title: Palestinians Hope Israeli Election Will Oust Netanyahu
item.description: Many in Gaza and the West Bank are desperate to avoid more years of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing government, which has made life close to unbearable.

item.title: Yemeni City of Taiz Running Out of Essentials as Houthis Close in
item.description: The Iranian-backed Houthi militia has cut road access to Taiz, one of Yemen’s largest cities, besieging it. Officials there warn of an impending humanitarian disaster.

item.media:description: A woman using a firewood oven on Monday during a shortage of cooking gas in Taiz, Yemen.
